description: Header file defining the InterfaceStateManagerImpl class, which implements interface state management by delegating to monitor and reader components, and maintains a cache of interface states.

classes.name: InterfaceStateManagerImpl
classes.description: Implements interface state management by delegating to monitor and reader, with caching of interface states.

methods.name: InterfaceStateManagerImpl
methods.description: Constructor that initializes monitor and reader components.

methods.name: ~InterfaceStateManagerImpl
methods.description: Destructor that cleans up event handlers.

methods.name: read_state
methods.description: Reads the current state of a network interface, using cache or delegating to the reader.

methods.name: get_state
methods.description: Retrieves the last known state of an interface from cache.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Updates the cached state of an interface.
